hooks.name: Fractured Shadows Continuity Check
hooks.description: Example campaign hook. Copy to .kiro/hooks/fractured-shadows-continuity.json once the campaign lives in campaigns/fractured-shadows/. Fires when an agent saves a session log and checks it against the bible's 12 continuity rules.

action.prompt: A Fractured Shadows session log was just saved. Read campaigns/fractured-shadows/BIBLE.md (sections 3 Safety, 5 House Rules, 11 Continuity Rules, 12 Canon Forks, Open Canon Questions) and campaigns/fractured-shadows/state.json, then check the saved log against every continuity rule. In particular: the name 'Draeven Vole' must not appear in narration or NPC dialogue unless state.json flags.name_draeven_confirmed is true; no gods answering or divine magic; no game-UI language in the fiction; every magic/Mark/Shard use has a Strain cost or described consequence; no fast travel without severe cost; no prophecy presented as true fate; Custodians never govern; no retired names; no species-as-morality; Alaric withholds but never lies; the Shadow Weaver is not seen directly before Arc III; the old world appears only as memory bleed. Also confirm every divergence from book canon is logged in bible section 12. Then run python3 tools/validate-campaign.py campaigns/fractured-shadows if a shell is available. Report a PASS/FAIL table with a fix for each FAIL.
